episodes.synopsis: Gintoki, Shinpachi, and Kagura receive a request from a man who wants them to make him stronger.
episodes.title: You Guys!! Do You Even Have a Gintama?! (1)

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki's group goes to take back a house for a man who's been conned.
episodes.title: You Guys!! Do You Even Have a Gintama?! (2)

episodes.synopsis: Sakata Gintoki meets Shimura Shinpachi.  The two proceeds to save Shinpachi's older sister from an amanto entertainment club.
episodes.title: Nobody with Naturally Wavy Hair Can be That Bad!

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki and Shinpachi meet an amanto alien girl who's been chased after by gangster.
episodes.title: Watch Out! Weekly Shonen JUMP Sometimes Comes Out on Saturdays!

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki's group's been asked to deliver a package to an amanto alien embassy.
episodes.title: Make Friends You Can Call by Their Nicknames, Even When You're an Old Fart!

episodes.synopsis: A man tries to break out of jail, to attend a pop star's concert.
episodes.title: Keep Your Promise Even If It Kills You

episodes.synopsis: The group is hired to find an amanto alien prince's pet.
episodes.title: Responsible Owners Should Clean Up After Their Pets!

episodes.synopsis: Shinpachi's sister is being stalked by a Shinsengumi officer.
episodes.title: There Is Butt a Fine Line Between Persistence and Stubbornness

episodes.synopsis: The Shinsengumi goes to avenge their commander's defeat.
episodes.title: Fighting Should Be Done With Fists!

episodes.synopsis: The group picks up a giant white dog.
episodes.title: Eat Something Sour When You're Tired!

episodes.synopsis: The trio helps an old man to track down a woman whom he met when he was young. Shown as a one hour special with episode 12.
episodes.title: Look, Overly Sticky Sweet Dumplings Are Not Real Dumplings, You Idiot!

episodes.synopsis: The kabuki district has been robbed by a mysterious thief.
episodes.title: People Who Make Good First Impressions Usually Suck!

episodes.synopsis: The group is hired to find a missing girl.  However, the group is dragged into deeper trouble than they originally anticipated.  Gintoki may require the help of his old friend Katsura to help him out of this mess.
episodes.title: If You're Going to Cosplay, Go All Out!

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - The Shinsengumi is asked to protect an amanto alien official.

Part 2 - Kagura meets a princess who's sneaked out from the castle.
episodes.title: Boys Have a Weird Ritual that Makes Them Think They Turn Into Men When They Touch Frogs! / You Only Gotta Wash Under Your Armpits - Just the Armpits

episodes.synopsis: The group enters Sadaharu in a pet competition, with Katsura and his pet being their opponent.
episodes.title: Pets Resemble Their Owners!

episodes.synopsis: A man who's been fired for assaulting an amanto royal goes job hunting, only to met with failure repeatedly.
episodes.title: If You Stop and Think About It, Your Life’s a Lot Longer as an Old Guy Than a Kid! Whoa, Scary!!

episodes.synopsis: A rebel plans to asssinate the shogun during a festival.
episodes.title: Sons Only Take After Their Fathers' Negative Attributes

episodes.synopsis: The group and Shinsengumi attempt to capture a man who's been stealing women's underwear.
episodes.title: Oh Yeah! Our Crib is Number One!

episodes.synopsis: In an effort to get some quick cash, Gintoki and Hasegawa, along with Shinpachi, Kagura, and Otae, head to the beach to get rid of a monster that's been terrorizing the area.
episodes.title: Why is the Sea So Salty? Because You City Folk Pee Whenever You Go Swimming!

episodes.synopsis: The Shinsengumi has been haunted by a mysterious being.
episodes.title: Watch Out For Conveyor Belts!

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - The group helps an amanto to protect his pond from developers.

Part 2 - Gintoki goes all over town trying to find an electric fan replacement during a heatwave.
episodes.title: If You're a Man, Try the Swordfish / If You Go to Sleep With the Fan On, You'll Get a Stomachache, So Be Careful

episodes.synopsis: A female ninja stays over at the Yorozuya.
episodes.title: Marriage is Prolonging an Illusion for Your Whole Life

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki, Shinpachi and Kagura go on a space trip in which Kagura had won tickets for.
episodes.title: When You're In a Fix, Keep On Laughing, Laughing...

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki and Katsura get dragged into being cross-dressers.
episodes.title: Cute Faces Are Always Hiding Something

episodes.synopsis: The series is entering into its third season! But the Yorozuya have other concerns: a battle of wits and deception to take reign of the sukiyaki pot!
episodes.title: A Shared Soup Pot is a Microcosm of Life

episodes.synopsis: The group goes to get Shinpachi's childhood friend out of a gang.
episodes.title: Don't Be Shy - Just Raise Your Hand and Say It

episodes.synopsis: After Okita showed them an underground death match arena (Rengokukan), the group proceeds to track down the reigning champion of those death matches.
episodes.title: Some Things Can’t Be Cut with a Sword

episodes.synopsis: A police department head official brings Kondo to a meeting to discuss the incident happened at the Rengokukan.
episodes.title: Good Things Never Come in Twos (But Bad Things Do)

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - An amanto goes around town to steal swords of value. Meanwhile Kagura steals Gintoki's wooden sword and tries to sell it.

Part 2 - Space cockroaches terrorize the town.
episodes.title: Don’t Panic – There’s a Return Policy! / I Told You to Pay Attention to the News!

episodes.synopsis: Otsu receives a threat letter.  The trio goes to investigate.
episodes.title: Even Teen Idols Act Like You Guys

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki has amnesia after a car accident.  His friends try to get his memory back.
episodes.title: You Always Remember the Things that Matter the Least

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki who still does not have his memory back, works at a factory which produces a mysterious items.  Meanwhile, Shinpachi and Kagura goes to retrieve Gintoki.
episodes.title: Life Moves on Like a Conveyor Belt

episodes.synopsis: Sakamoto sends two amanto craftsmen to help rebuild the Yorozuya as repayment for him crashing his spaceship into the place.
episodes.title: Mistaking Someone’s Name is Rude!

episodes.synopsis: Shinpachi saves a girl with cat ears while on a train ride.  Later in a letter she sends him, the girl proceeds to ask him out.
episodes.title: Love Doesn’t Require a Manual (1)

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - Shinpachi deals with the kitty-dressed thief.

Part 2 - Matsudaira gets Kondou, Hijikata, and Okita to help get his daughter to dump her boyfriend who he does not approve of.
episodes.title: Love Doesn’t Require a Manual (2) / You Can't Judge a Person by His Appearance, Either

episodes.synopsis: A colleague of Otae has been scammed of her money by a cult.  The Yorozuya and Otae goes to uncover the secret of the cult.
episodes.title: People with Dark Pasts Can't Shut Up

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - Gintoki meets Santa and has to help him deliver gifts.

Part 2 - Gintoki and Hattori fight over a year end double-issue of Jump (magazine).
episodes.title: People Who Say that Santa Doesn’t Really Exist Actually Want to Believe in Him / Prayer Won't Make Your Worldly Desires Go Away! Control Yourself

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - Everyone's participating in the neighborhood snow building contest-- with disastrous results.

Part 2 - An old man tries to get his wife to look at his fireworks & enjoy it.
episodes.title: Only Children Play in the Snow / Eating Ice Cream In Winter Is Awesome

episodes.synopsis: Katsura injures his leg while escaping from the Shinsengumi and uses a ramen shop as a temporary hideout.
episodes.title: Ramen Shops with Long Menus Never Do Well

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious and famous hunter, Umibouzu, pays a visit when an alien appears in Edo.
episodes.title: Give a Thought to Planned Pregnancy

episodes.synopsis: Dissatisfied with Gintoki's reaction to Kagura's departure, Shinpachi quits and goes after Kagura.
episodes.title: You Can't Judge a Movie by Its Title

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki, along with Umibouzu, goes to combat the alien while at the same time avoiding the Shogunate's side of attack (on the alien).
episodes.title: You Know What Happens if You Pee on a Worm

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - Otae, Sa-chan, and Catherine all try to go for the series' heroine position.

Part 2 - Katsura enlists the Yorozuya to help him save Elizabeth-- but they need some ninja finesse to do it first.
episodes.title: Make Characters So Anybody Can Tell Who They Are by Just Their Silhouettes / Since It Ended a Bit Early, We're Starting the Next One

episodes.synopsis: Katsura, along with the Yorozuya, goes to find Sarutobi Ayame to train them on ninja skills in preparation for their Elizabeth rescue.
episodes.title: Mom’s Busy, Too, So Quit Complaining About What’s for Dinner

episodes.synopsis: Sadaharu becomes a demon that the Yorozuya tries to rescue with the help of former priestess sisters.
episodes.title: Walk Your Dog at an Appropriate Speed

episodes.synopsis: Otae and Ane square off to keep their jobs by trying to out-earn each other.
episodes.title: Adults Only. We Wouldn’t Want Anyone Immature in Here

episodes.synopsis: The Yorozuya get a new neighbor, a frightening looking Amanto named Hedoro, and assume he's up to something.
episodes.title: Do Cherries Come from Cherry Trees?

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - A group of assassins want to take Hijikata out. The problem: none of them really expected what would happen when he encountered Gintoki

Part 2 - Gintoki, Shinpachi and Kagura encounter an old man and are "forced" to play games with him; meanwhile, Sa-chan's master passed away and she went to attend his funeral.
episodes.title: The More You're Alike, the More You Fight / Whatever You Play, Play to Win

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki and Hasegawa run into some gambling problems.
episodes.title: A Life Without Gambling is Like Sushi Without Wasabi

episodes.synopsis: The cast goes over their ideas for the series' new direction.
episodes.title: Pending Means Pending, It's Not Final

episodes.synopsis: A baby is dropped off in front of the Yorozuya with a note claiming it's Gintoki's son.
episodes.title: Milk Should Be Served at Body Temperature

episodes.synopsis: It is revealed that the baby isn't Gintoki's; instead the baby was left at Yorozuya by the mother to keep her child safe from her father-in-law. Meanwhile Kagura and Shinpachi try to save the mother; Gintoki is on his way to return the baby.
episodes.title: If You Want to See Someone, Make an Appo First

episodes.synopsis: While trying to burn old JUMP issues, Gintoki is captured by a female fire fighter in search of a local arsonist.
episodes.title: Stress Makes You Bald, but It's Stressful to Avoid Stress, So You End Up Stressed Out Anyway, So in the End There's Nothing You Can Do

episodes.synopsis: A mother looking for her son in Edo enlists the help of Yorozuya.
episodes.title: Mothers Everywhere Are All the Same

episodes.synopsis: Continuing from the last episode, it is discovered that the son turned out to be the No.1 "Pimp" in Kabuki District.
episodes.title: Don't Make Munching Noises When You Eat

episodes.synopsis: Terakado Tsu (Otsu) goes to be one day chief of the Shinsengumi to improve its image.
episodes.title: Keep an Eye on the Chief for the Day

episodes.synopsis: Mutsu requests the Yorozuya recover some stolen cargo.
episodes.title: When Looking For Things You've Lost, Remember What You Were Doing On The Day You Lost It

episodes.synopsis: A serial killer has been going around town-- and one of the crew meets him head on! In the meantime, Gintoki is requested to locate "Benizakura", an unlucky sword stolen from its owner.
episodes.title: Croquette Sandwiches Are Always the Most Popular Food Sold at the Stalls

episodes.synopsis: Kagura gets captured. Tetsuko goes to visit the injured Gintoki and tells him the truth about the Benizakura sword.
episodes.title: Be Careful Not to Leave Your Umbrella Somewhere

episodes.synopsis: Shinpachi and Elizabeth go on the ship to attack Okada.  A battle rages on the ship, at which Kagura manages to escape from captivity.  On the other hand, Gintoki and Tetsuko (Benizakura forger Tetsuya's sister) head towards Takasugi.
episodes.title: The Sun Will Rise Again

episodes.synopsis: The battle comes to a conclusion, with Benizakura finally taken over Okada's body, and Gintoki will have to use the sword Tetsuko gave him to stop this.
episodes.title: On a Moonless Night, Insects Are Drawn to the Light

episodes.synopsis: Yamasaki is sent by Hijikata to investigate what has happened with that fight between Katsura and Takasugi groups.  He goes around asking different people, though fails to get any real answers.
episodes.title: Even Mummy Hunters Sometimes Turn into Mummys

episodes.synopsis: Hattori Zenzo has been hired to kidnap a girl who is able to foresee the future.  Meanwhile, the Yorozuya has been hired to protect the very same girl.
episodes.title: The Preview Section in JUMP is Always Unreliable

episodes.synopsis: A set of TV crews follow Katsura around for a day to do a television program special interview.
episodes.title: Eating Nmaibo Can Make You Full in No Time!

episodes.synopsis: Kagura's beetle was killed during a beetle fighting match.  She tries to drag Gintoki and Shinpachi to go beetle hunting with her.  That only succeeds when they know there is a high demand for the beetles - meaning they can make money of it.  The trio encounters the Shinsengumi who also happens to be capturing beetles for reason unknown.
episodes.title: Rhinoceros Beetles Teach Boys that Life is Precious

episodes.synopsis: An old dango shop owner accepts a challenge from the owner of a popular new dessert shop.
episodes.title: Dango Over Flowers

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - Gintoki gets into an accident with a delivery girl who has the "Need for Speed"

Part 2 - As Gintoki recovers from the delivery incident, Sa-chan is forced to weigh both her feminine needs and her assassin duties when working a mission at the same hospital.
episodes.title: For the Wind Is the Life / The Ideal Girlfriend Is Always Minami

episodes.synopsis: Every year during the Matsuri festival, a "Test of Courage" is held. This year Gintoki, Shinpachi and Kagura help out with the event.
episodes.title: Like a Haunted House, Life is Filled with Horrors

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki finds a female android head in the trash.
episodes.title: Please Help by Separating Your Trash

episodes.synopsis: It's revealed that the android head belonged to a murder suspect. Two other androids were sent to retrieve the android head along with a horde of maid androids.
episodes.title: Too Many Cuties Can Make You Sick

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki, Shinpachi, Kagura, and the robot tinkerer head towards the main facility of the inventor and attempt to shutdown the rampaging maid android mob.
episodes.title: Some Data Cannot Be Erased

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - Sadaharu is in "heat" and Yorozuya tries to find him a mate.

Part 2 - Katsura attempts to take a driving lesson -- a "Might Happen" driving lesson, that is.
episodes.title: A Dog's Paws Smell Fragrant / Drive With a "Might" Attitude

episodes.synopsis: While hunting mushrooms in the woods, Gintoki, Shinpachi and Kagura become infected with mentality-changing mushrooms while getting get involved in a tragic war between a bear and a hunter.
episodes.title: Think for a Minute Now, Do Matsutake Mushrooms Really Taste All that Good?

episodes.synopsis: Edo's under attack by M-unibrow zombies!
episodes.title: The Manga Writer Becomes a Pro, After Doing a Stock of Manuscripts

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki, Shinpachi and Kagura recaps what has happened to date on their 2nd Year Anniversary special.
episodes.title: Don’t Complain About Your Job at Home, Do It Somewhere Else

episodes.synopsis: Otae's childhood friend, Kyubei Yagyu appears and takes Otae back to fufil her childhood promise.
episodes.title: In Those Situations, Keep Quiet and Cook Red Rice With Beans

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki, Shinpachi, Kagura, Kondo, Hijikata and Sogo goes to the Yagyu family premises and attempts to get Otae back.
episodes.title: Yesterday’s Enemy, After All Is Said and Done, Is Still the Enemy

episodes.synopsis: The battle at the Yagyu family premises continues.
episodes.title: People Who Are Picky About Food Are Also Picky About People, Too

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki, Isao, Toujou, and Binbokusai are in the toilet, all looking for something to wipe....
episodes.title: Four Heads are Better than One

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Gintoki and Binbokusai begins; meanwhile, Shinpachi discovered that Kyubei was girl.
episodes.title: When Someone Who Wears Glasses Takes Them Off, It Looks Like Something’s Missing

episodes.synopsis: The final episode in the Yagyu story arc.
episodes.title: A Woman's Best Make-up Is Her Smile

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - The Yorozuya attempt to rid a town of monsters for some quick cash

Part 2 - The piggish Amanto female saved by the Yorozuya from the drug pirates enlists them to save her boyfriend from his former gang.
episodes.title: You Don't Stand in Line for the Ramen, You Stand in Line for the Self-Satisfaction / You Say Kawaii So Often, You Must Really Think You're Cute Stuff

episodes.synopsis: The cold/flu season hits hard; Yorozuya is enlisted to help out at Otae's workplace.
episodes.title: Rank Has Nothing to Do with Luck

episodes.synopsis: A washed out detective tells his tale about his life-long quest of pursuing of a thief who turned from righteous to evil.
episodes.title: Hard-boiled Egg on a Man's Heart

episodes.synopsis: The detective, Gintoki, Shinpachi and Kagura crashed into a mansion in an attempt to capture the thief.
episodes.title: Hard-Boiled Eggs Don't Crack

episodes.synopsis: Sougo's older sister, Mitsuba, arrived in Edo for a visit. Hijikata and Mitsuba's relationship is revealed.
episodes.title: It's Often Difficult to Sleep When You're Engrossed With Counting Sheep

episodes.synopsis: Mitsuba is in bad condition due to her sickness; Sougo decides to go help Hijikata.
episodes.title: Perform a German Suplex on a Woman Who Asks If She or the Job Is More Important

episodes.synopsis: Tojo Ayumu enlisted the help of Yorozuya to help make a "woman" out of the tomboyish Kyubei. Gintoki's solution: a Gokon.
episodes.title: The Most Exciting Part of a Group Date is Before it Starts

episodes.synopsis: The spirit of the sword that Gintoki carries appears to teach Gintoki, Shinpachi and Kagura an ultimate technique.
episodes.title: What Happens Twice, Happens Thrice

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki, Shinpachi, Kagura and Hasegawa are hospitalized (The Yorozuya gang for food poisoning from eating unfresh crabs; Hasegawa got knocked down by a car). They get themselves involved when a young nurse falls in love with one of her patients.
episodes.title: The More Delicious the Food, the Nastier It Is When It Goes Bad

episodes.synopsis: Our female characters joined a "slimming" camp to shed off their extra weights.
episodes.title: If You Want To Lose Weight, Then Stop Eating and Start Moving

episodes.synopsis: An assassin has been hired to kill Matsudaira but encounters unexpected scenarios while carrying out the task.
episodes.title: Be a Person Who Can See People's Strong Points and Not Their Weak Points

episodes.synopsis: It's Valentine's Day, and a space heroine comes to Edo to confess her intention to...
episodes.title: Even a Hero Has Issues

episodes.synopsis: Hasegawa gets a job. While commuting on his first day, an accident lands him in jail with harassment charges.
episodes.title: When Riding A Train, Make Sure You Grab the Straps With Both Hands

episodes.synopsis: The trial of Hasegawa's harassment charge comes to a conclusion.
episodes.title: Men, Be a Madao

episodes.synopsis: A planet is attacked by mysterious beings. It's up to Umibouzu to settle things and put an end to the attack. How will the end turn out?
episodes.title: If You're a Man, Don't Give Up

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - Old gangmates of Catherine try to convince her to join them on a heist.

Part 2 - Gintoki gets sick. Kagura takes over running odd-jobs for the day.
episodes.title: Exaggerate the Tales of Your Exploits by a Third, So Everyone Has a Good Time / Men Have a Weakness for Girls Who Sell Flowers and Work in Pastry Shops

episodes.synopsis: The popular game console "Owee" is finally on sale. The otaku, as well as the Yorozuya and the Shinsengumi are at the store trying to get their hands on the consoles.
episodes.title: Play Video Games for Only an Hour a Day

episodes.synopsis: Yorozuya and Shinsengumi are divided into two teams to play against each other in a video-gaming contest for a chance to win a free "Owee".
episodes.title: Life and Video Games are Full of Bugs

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki gives his suggestions to the editor and author of "Gintaman" on what should the series improve on.
episodes.title: The More Something Is Disliked, the More Lovely It Is

episodes.synopsis: Some Shinsengumi member shows up, and it is soon revealed to be a rival of Hijikata.
episodes.title: Rules Are Made to be Broken

episodes.synopsis: Itou Kamotarou (appeared on the previous episode) proceeds with his agenda. Hijikata seeks help from the Yorozuya to save the Shinsengumi from destruction.
episodes.title: Otaku Are Talkative

episodes.synopsis: Okita appears to save Kondou from the rebel Shinsengumi led by Itou. The Yorozuya along with Hijikata are also on their way to the scene.
episodes.title: There's a Thin Line Between Strengths and Weaknesses

episodes.synopsis: Now fully free from the curse, Hijikata battles against Itou. Meanwhile, Gintoki is forced into a confrontation with none other than Bansai, right hand man to Takasugi.
episodes.title: Important Things Are Hard To See

episodes.synopsis: The concluding finale to the Shinsengumi Crisis Arc.
episodes.title: It’s All About the Beat and Timing

episodes.synopsis: Kagura accidentally knocks out an international soccer team when their captain was out by giving them water from a janitor's bucket. Now the Yorozuya and others have to fill the team's spots.
episodes.title: Love Is Often Played Out In Sudden Death

episodes.synopsis: The Yorozuya are requested to help a Yakuza boss's son who has become a hikikomori, but little do they know how dangerous this job could turn out to be...
episodes.title: Kids Don’t Understand How Their Parents Feel

episodes.synopsis: The Yorozuya's Yakuza client has died, and the group's young new leader carries a dark secret about the boss's son.
episodes.title: Some Things Are Better Left Unsaid

episodes.synopsis: Yamazaki, with the intent of spying on the Joui faction, undergoes the necessary testing and training as one of its new recruits.
episodes.title: Life is a test

episodes.synopsis: Katsura is inprisoned, and fellow inmate Suekichi tries to find a way to make Katsura fall asleep so that he can make his escape.
episodes.title: People Are All Escapees of Their Own Inner Prisons

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - Yorozuya's asked by a crossdresser hostess to help with the courting of a host.

Part 2 - A story about Kagura and an umbrella during the rainy season.
episodes.title: Definitely Do Not Let Your Girlfriend See the Things You Use for Cross-Dressing / There's Almost a 100% Chance You’ll Forget Your Umbrella and Hate Yourself For It

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - Katsura briefly takes over the series in an attempt to promote his birthday.

Part 2 - Gintoki attempts to help Tama find a way to enjoy herself.
episodes.title: A Birthday in Your Twenties Has No Deep Meaning / Lucky Is a Man Who Gets Up and Goes to Work

episodes.synopsis: A member of the Shinsengumi suggests a "washroom revolution". Eventually it evolves into a battle of Shinsengumi vs. washroom germs.
episodes.title: Cleaning the Toilet Cleanses the Soul

episodes.synopsis: Hijikata tells Matsudaira that he would fend off the store clerks who are coming-on to Matsudaira's daughter, Kuriko, just so he'd spare their lives. Kuriko mistakes Hijikata as some other person and starts to have feelings for him.
episodes.title: They Say Soy Sauce On Pudding Tastes Like Sea Urchin, But Soy Sauce On Pudding Only Tastes Like Pudding and Soy Sauce

episodes.synopsis: While Gintoki, Shinpachi, Kagura, Hasegawa, Tae, Kyuubei and Katsura are on their way to the legendary Dragon Palace, a quarrel between them ends up bringing them onto an isolated island.
episodes.title: Summer Vacation is the Most Fun Right Before It Begins

episodes.synopsis: Kamenashi (the turtle) tells the group about Otohime, the owner of the Dragon Palace, and that they are the only ones who are capable of stopping her plan.
episodes.title: The Older, the Wiser

episodes.synopsis: The group goes to save Tae. On their way, Shinpachi, Gintoki and Katsura stumble upon a room where they learn about Otohime's past.
episodes.title: Beauty Is Like a Summer Fruit

episodes.synopsis: Otohime's past lover's will gives the antidote to the aging virus to Shinpachi. However, their time is limited as a missile carrying another batch of the virus aimed at Edo is about to be sent off.
episodes.title: Even if Your Back is Bent, Go Straight Forward

episodes.synopsis: Smoking ban comes to Edo. Heavy smoker Hijikata is desperate to find cigarettes.
episodes.title: Within Each Box of Cigarettes, Are One or Two Cigarettes That Smell Like Horse Dung

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - Katsura goes undercover at an Amanto-only Japanese restaurant to stop a radical branch of the Joi Faction's plan of causing havoc.

Part 2 - Hasegawa takes over a sushi bar while the owner is in the hospital. The Yorozuya end up helping after the sushi machine went out of order.
episodes.title: Japanese Restaurants Abroad Taste Pretty Much Like School Cafeteria Lunches / Once You've Taken a Dish, You Can't Put It Back

episodes.synopsis: The Yorozuya goes into the world of online role playing game (RPG) to search for the Amantos who are responsible for turning part of their bodies into screwdriver heads.
episodes.title: Novices Only Need a Flathead and a Phillips

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki, Shinpachi, and Kagura go around in the online role playing game to find powerful players to be their companions on their search for the Amanto. Their new found companions however, are not what they seem to be.
episodes.title: Imagination Is Nurtured In the 8th Grade

episodes.synopsis: Everyone seems to have given up on getting their original bodies back except for Ayame, who continues to gather leads to organize one final attempt in the real world, but she'll need the others to help.
episodes.title: Always Keep a Screwdriver In Your Heart

episodes.synopsis: Otsu has overcome her past scandals and become Edo's top idol. And the release date of her new single has finally been announced! Shinpachi and her other fans are overjoyed at the news. But trouble arises right before the release. Otsu's music producer, Tsunpo, is late with the creation of her song and says the release will be postponed.
episodes.title: When Nagging Goes Too Far It Becomes Intimidating

episodes.synopsis: On news of the series entering its final arc, the characters go over their choice of best moments in the series.
episodes.title: Entering the Final Chapter!

episodes.synopsis: The fan club members for Edo's top idol, Tsu Terakado, are at the beach practicing their choreography for an upcoming concert. But Takachin notices his fellow members’ enthusiasm getting sloppy. One of the fan club officers has started exchanging e-mails with a girl he met through a blog. Shinpachi is furious the officer has broken their club rule of “Secret communication with women is forbidden.” As their captain, he puts some spirit into them, but…
episodes.title: Some Things Can Only Be Conveyed Through the Written Word

episodes.synopsis: Even though it’s believed the letters are coming from Okita, Shinpachi's response letter turn out to be a big hit. Urara is happy her older sister has received a response to her letters. But her older sister confesses that she sent Urara's picture with the letter. And it looks like both Shinpachi and Urara sent someone else's pictures with their letters!
episodes.title: Sometimes You Must Meet to Understand

episodes.synopsis: Urara's older sister learns that Shinpachi sent Okita's picture with his letters. Shinpachi desperately tries to apologize, but Urara's older sister tells him that she wants to help him get Urara to like him. Afterwards, Gintoki and the others meet up with Urara and Okita. They try to get Urara's attention, but she is only interested in Okita. Urara's older sister can’t do anything about it and runs away in regret. Shinpachi is worried and goes after her, but…
episodes.title: Sometimes You Can’t Tell Just By Meeting Someone

episodes.synopsis: Worried about her pet’s sudden drop in appetite, Kagura takes Sadaharu to the veterinary hospital. Katsura happens to be there as well, explaining how Elizabeth is in bad health and has been hospitalized to undergo surgery. Fortunately Sadaharu’s condition is nothing serious, but he’s kept overnight just to be safe. Around the same time, an old dog that has also been hospitalized is about to take its last breath. It seems the owner is in critical condition as well, and with only death awaiting them both, Kagura decides to take the old dog to its owner.
episodes.title: Beware of Food You Pick Up Off the Ground

episodes.synopsis: To let the dying dog Kintaro see its owner for one last time, Kagura and Katsura sneak it out of the hospital…only to find themselves caught in the war between the “Planet Eaters” (dogs) and “Planet Pukers” (cats), while Earth’s fate hangs in the balance. Escaping from the Planet Pukers, who are after Kintaro, the two head to the hospital where the old man is hospitalized. Meanwhile, the old man, who is supposedly in critical condition, goes missing. The old man’s children request Gintoki’s services, but when he arrives at the hospital…
episodes.title: Cat Lovers and Dog Lovers Are Mutually Exclusive

episodes.synopsis: Otose arranges for Gintoki and the gang to spend their winter break at a hot spring inn located deep in the mountains. Anticipating a secluded hot spring bath, the group hikes their way up the mountain trail, only to arrive at a completely deserted and run-down inn. With no available bus to return to Edo, the gang has no choice but to stay at the inn. The inn’s Okami Oiwa welcomes the group, but Gintoki and Shinpachi notice a transparent being standing behind her back!
episodes.title: Fights Often Ensue During Trips

episodes.synopsis: The inn Gintoki and the gang are staying at turns out to be a ghost inn where all the stands (ghosts) gather, unable to enter heaven due to their attachment to the living world! Gintoki finds himself left all alone after Shinpachi, Kagura, and Otae are all possessed by stands. The Okami Oiwa explains she was looking for someone tough enough to help run the inn. Forced into working as an employee trainee, Gintoki must now join his co-worker Rei to greet the visiting stand customers…
episodes.title: Briefs Will Unavoidably Get Skidmarks

episodes.synopsis: Sick and tired of Oiwa’s tyranny, Gintoki decides to shut down the inn by teaming up with Rei. He plans to use Nobunaga, Hideyoshi, and Mitsuhide (their stands, that is) to bring down the inn’s reputation but is stopped by Okami Otose. Though overwhelmed at first by Okami’s most powerful stand Tagosaku, Gintoki nonetheless manages to exorcize the inn’s customers with the help of Shinpachi and the gang, who are now themselves living stands. With the fate of the inn and himself at stake, Gintoki finally enters a one-on-one battle with Oiwa.
episodes.title: Gin and His Excellency's Good-for-Nothings

episodes.synopsis: Oiwa lets Tagosaku possess her own body to become “His Excellency.” Fueled by anger and sadness, her surge of attacks gradually corner Gintoki. But just in the nick of time, Gintoki also lets himself be possessed by Stands to become “His Excellency.” To bring down the wasted ghost inn, Gintoki risks everything he has to go up against Oiwa!
episodes.title: Be Very Careful When Using Ghost Stories

episodes.synopsis: Once, the manga Gintaman gained immense popularity in Jump magazine, and was even made into an animated series thanks to Gintoki’s random advice. Ofuji has since taken over from Konishi as editor of Gintaman… But now the manga’s popularity is on a steady decline! Under these desperate circumstances, Gintoki is once again called forth to help fix the problem! Strong criticism and heated debate ensue between Ofuji, Konishi, and Amachi Sensei, along with their special guest. In the end, what sort of breakthrough solution have they come up with?!
episodes.title: Before Thinking About the Earth, Think About the More Endangered Gintaman’s Future!

episodes.synopsis: As always, Hasegawa, aka MADAO idles away his life. While talking on the phone with his estranged wife Hatsu, Hasegawa ends up inviting her over to his house. But thanks to a string of misfortunes, his home is now a cardboard box in the park! Having told Hatsu that he lives in a pretty nice place, Hasegawa asks Gintoki to help him look for decent housing…
episodes.title: It's Your House, You Build It

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - After so many attempts and failures, Sarutobi and Kondo try to play matchmaker to get the other's love for them to win a bet.

Part 2 - In the second part, Gintoki meets Santa and Ben (his reindeer) as they reunite.
episodes.title: 99% of Men Aren't Confident in Confessing Their Love / People Who Don't Believe in Santa Are the Very Ones Who Want to Believe, You Contentious Bastard

episodes.synopsis: It’s the usual scene at Odd Jobs Gin. Shinpachi and Kagura are cleaning up the place when they see a picture fall out of the back of a wall frame. To their surprise, the picture is a shot of Gintoki and a mystery beauty! Could she be a woman from his past? While the two argue over the woman’s identity, Gintoki returns with the groceries and reveals a surprising truth. The woman in the picture was the semi-regular character in the “previous” Odd Jobs Gin. For the first time ever, before even Shinpachi or Kagura joined, the story of when Gintoki just started running the Odd Jobs business is revealed…
episodes.title: Let's Talk About the Old Days Once in a While

episodes.synopsis: Seita is a kid who makes his living through pickpocketing. One day Seita picks Gintoki’s wallet only to find it pretty much empty, and discovers that his own wallet was picked back in return. In the end Seita treats Gintoki to some parfait after getting caught red-handed. Brought into Snack Otose for questioning, Seita shocks everyone by revealing he needed the money to see a certain “遊女/Yujo (courtesans/ prostitute).”
episodes.title: Don't Put Your Wallet In Your Back Pocket

episodes.synopsis: Seita was picking pockets to see Hinowa, the highest-ranked 遊女/Yujo (courtesans/ prostitute) in the underground 遊郭/Yukaku (Licensed Quarters) Yoshiwara Tougenkyo, where law has no meaning. But his picking act was all for the sake of seeing the mother he was separated from at a young age. To let Seita see Hinowa, Gintoki and the gang march into Yoshiwara Tougenkyo, where they receive a rough welcome by Tsukuyo – the head of Yoshiwara’s paramilitary force, “Hyakka.”
episodes.title: Beware of Those Who Use an Umbrella on a Sunny Day!

episodes.synopsis: Kagura’s older brother Kamui arrives in Yoshiwara. As the Seventh Division Captain of the Space Pirate Harusame, Kamui is here to talk with the division’s former captain, The Night King, Hosen. At first everything seems to go well, but tensions gradually start to build up… Meanwhile, escaping from Kamui and his men’s attack, Gintoki and the gang take refuge at Tsukuyo’s hideout.
episodes.title: Butting Into a Fight is Dangerous

episodes.synopsis: As Gintoki and the gang head toward Hosen’s lair, they encounter Abuki, one of Kamui’s subordinates, and are overwhelmed by the incredible fighting power of the Yato Clan. On Shinpachi and Kagura’s urging, Gintoki heads out to face Hosen alone. The remaining two fight desperately against Abuki, only to be cornered by the overwhelming difference in power. In the midst of the fierce battle Kagura renews her feelings toward her older brother Kamui and her reason for fighting. But with Shinpachi’s life in danger, Kagura goes through a dramatic transformation…
episodes.title: Life Is About Making Consecutive Decisions

episodes.synopsis: Amidst the fierce battle, Kagura awakens to her Yato instincts and defeats Abuto. Thanks to Shinpachi’s desperate plea, Kagura is able to return to her senses and together they head after Hosen. Meanwhile Kamui has brought Seita before Hinowa, who is confined to her quarters. “Mom, let’s go home together!” Seita shouts out to his beloved mother. However, unexpected words leave Hinowa’s mouth…
episodes.title: Those Who Stand On Four Legs Are Beasts. Those Who Stand on Two Legs, Guts, and Glory, Are Men

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki arrives before Hosen, just in the nick of time. To restore the bond between mother and son that has been torn by the city of eternal light, Gintoki engages Hosen with fierce determination. But against the King of the Night’s awesome powers, Gintoki is beaten helplessly to the ground. “Go home to the world above with your mom…” Taking to heart the words left by Gintoki, Seita tries to escape from Yoshiwara with Hinowa, but…
episodes.title: Don’t Trust Bedtime Stories

episodes.synopsis: The only way to defeat Hosen is to bring back the Sun to the Yoshiwara Shangri-La, the city trapped within eternal night. Seita runs for the control room to break open the iron-plated seal covering the city. Meanwhile, Gintoki and the Hyakka led by Tsukuyo are desperately holding off Hosen’s attack. But despite their best efforts, they cannot stop the King of The Night’s onslaught…
episodes.title: The Color for Each Person’s Bond Comes in Various Colors

episodes.synopsis: At last the sun rises above Yoshiwara Shangri-La, the city of eternal light. At the end of a fierce battle, Hosen finally reveals his true feelings for Hinowa and passes away. Observing the entire battle from afar, Kamui is greeted by Kagura and Shinpachi. Kagura is enraged with her reunited brother, but Kamui leaves after “declaring war” with Gintoki.
episodes.title: The Taste of Drinking Under Broad Daylight Is Something Special

episodes.synopsis: It is shortly after the fierce battle at Yoshiwara Shngri-la. Shinpachi and Kagura, having faced powerful foes in Hosen and Kamui unlike any they have encountered, are training hard after realizing their lack of strength. Both announce to Gintoki their determination to become stronger. But Gintoki declines to become involved, saying it’s a pain. Learning of the situation, Otae and Hasegawa share their training secrets, but…
episodes.title: All Adults are Instructors for All Children

episodes.synopsis: During their routine night patrol Hijikata and Okita are attacked and kidnapped by an unknown assailant. When they wake up, the two find themselves chained together and imprisoned inside an abandoned room. As the two come to realize how bad the situation is, a creepy man speaks to them over the monitor. The man, who calls himself Jigzaw, reveals that he has placed a bomb at the Shinsengumi headquarters, and that the only way Hijikata and Okita can escape is for one to kill the other!
episodes.title: Zip Up Your Fly Nice and Slowly

episodes.synopsis: As the bombing of the Shinsengumi headquarters nears, Hijikata and Okita are still unable to find any means for escape. Only one key exists to unlock the shackles chaining each other. But if the key is used, it will set off a bomb to kill the other. The rule of the devil begins to stir distrust between the two. Though he commends them for not betraying one another, Jigzaw pressures them to make the final decision by displaying a certain item.
episodes.title: When Breaking a Chuubert in Half, the End with the Knob Should Be Better. It's Also Tasty to Drink from There

episodes.synopsis: The Odd Jobs trio is going about their usual meaningless chatter when a man with an eye-patch suddenly shows up and begins “ordering” them around. The man’s “power” is so strong, the Odd Jobs find themselves unable to defy his orders…
episodes.title: If You Can’t Beat Them, Join Them

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki visits a barber shop to get his hair cut. After Kagura mentions that the seventh volume of the manga Abu is missing, the barber runs off to buy the volume and leaves the Yorozuya to look after the shop. After a while Katsura and Kondo enter the shop to get an image change. Then the Shogun enters suddenly the shop and wants a hair cut, too. The Yorozuya fall into despair because they don't even know how to cut hair properly.
episodes.title: A Conversation With a Barber During a Haircut is The Most Pointless Thing in The World

episodes.synopsis: The Shogun wants Gintoki, Kagura and Shinpachi to redo his mage. After Kagura is trying to ask the Shogun how he wants his hair done, she vomits and a Naruto gets stuck on the Shogun's head. Then the three Yorozuya try removing it with a razor and accidentally cut off the Shogun's mage. To cover up their mistake they try to find a replace for it.
episodes.title: The Heavens Created Chonmage Above Man Instead of Another Man

episodes.synopsis: Kagura can't fall asleep , so she goes to Gintoki's room and troubles him about her problem. After few methods, she finally fells asleep while listening to a story from a radio show. Unfortunately Gintoki listened to this Horror story as well, and now he can't fall aleep.
episodes.title: Sleep Helps a Child Grow

episodes.synopsis: Otae and Shinpachi are invited to Kyubei’s birthday party. The two arrive at the Yagyu mansion with a birthday cake in hand, only to find the place filled with celebrities from the entertainment and political worlds and other various industries! When the two begin to feel out of place, they spot Gintoki, Katsura, Hasegawa, and Kamenashi (without his shell) causing a huge commotion. Naturally, with these members together in one place trouble is bound to happen…
episodes.title: That Person Looks Different from Usual During a Birthday Party

episodes.synopsis: Hasegawa is tired of alway losing and being called a Madao, so together with Gintoki they bet on horse races. After many failures, Hasegawa tells him of his effort to leave the "Madao Spiral", unfortunate turn of events that happened since he gained the nickname. Together with Gintoki Madao decides to try one last time, betting on the horse Justaway. In the middle of the race Gintoki tells him that he bet on another horse and after a head on head race between Justaway and Gin's horse Cheap Impact, it seemed at first that Justaway won but then it got disqualified and Cheap Impact won instead. But by that time Gin has already shred his ticket into pieces and neither of them won.
episodes.title: The Other Side of the Other Side of the Other Side Would Be the Other Side

episodes.synopsis: Yatai “Guchiri-Ya” (Whining Store) has three rules: One, a customer can come in alone and whine as much as they want. Two, if there’s a familiar face, pretend like you don’t know them. And three, do not share the stories you hear. Tonight’s customers are a drowsy-looking samurai with a sweet tooth, a Mayo samurai, and finally Mr. Gorilla (pseudonym). Though permitted to whine, the three customers cannot help feeling awkward about it. So the master speaks on their behalf and spills their usual complaints, causing panic amongst the group. Just then, a familiar-looking woman enters the Yatai and begins attacking the other customers with sharp words (and weapons)!
episodes.title: It Takes a Bit of Courage to Enter a Street Vendor's Stand

episodes.synopsis: Today’s Tsu Terakado concert is another lively success. But fan club president Shinpachi is angered because only four of the Tsu Terakado fan club members have come to the concert. He is further enraged to learn that many of the club members have left without permission and have joined the new Tsusentai fan club instead. To Shinpachi’s surprise, the Tsusentai leader is Hijikata, who thanks to the demonic sword’s curse has now become a charismatic otaku! Can Shinpachi protect his only(?) distinctive trait from Tosshi’s onslaught?!
episodes.title: Any Place Can Become a Battlefield When Men Gather

episodes.synopsis: The fierce battle begins over the title of the Official Tsu Terakado fan club. Tosshi, Hijikata’s loser otaku personality created from a demonic sword, was once thought to have been defeated by Hijikata’s strong will, but in reality the personality still survives within him. By reigning as the king of otaku, Hijikata plans to put Tosshi’s soul to rest. Tosshi’s road to the king of otaku versus Shinpachi’s love for Otsu-chan. Who shall be victorious?!
episodes.title: If a Friend Gets Injured, Take Him to the Hospital, Stat!

episodes.synopsis: The preliminary round for the Official Tsu Terakado fan club title is a marathon race. With Takachin in critical condition and Kagura taking the wrong route, team Shinpachi’s chances of winning look slim. But thanks to Gintoki’s quick thinking, Takachin makes an instant (and improved?) recovery and emerges from the hospital to rejoin the race! As the race gradually turns into a battle of deception, Shinpachi runs furiously for the goal. Will he be able to beat the tactical general Tosshi?!
episodes.title: If One Orange in the Box Is Rotten, the Rest of Them Will Become Rotten Before You Realize It

episodes.synopsis: Tosshi finishes the preliminary race in first place by rounding up all the contestants to block Shinpachi’s team from making the goal. Despite Toshi’s scheming, team Otsu-chan fan club makes a surprising comeback to finish in second place! Hijikata points out that the team cheated by changing their member lineup, but with his own member suspected of using a taxi, the objection is dropped. Kondo and Kagura also finish the race after taking the wrong route and being dropped off by the police. Meanwhile, what happened to Shinpachi who’s still in the race? That being said and done, the main event finally takes place!
episodes.title: From a Foreigner's Perspective, You're the Foreigner. From an Alien's Perspective, You're the Alien

episodes.synopsis: For the second round in the Official Tsu Terakado fan club championships, it is a battle of charms. Both teams must come up with a virtualized situation where the winner is decided by Otsu-chan saying “yes.” First up is the Tsusengumi’s story, taking place in a bar with a beautiful night view. But the romantic mood is ruined thanks to Okita the narrator and assistants Kondo and “Mohawk” Yamazaki going out of control. Hijikata begins to panic, but with Kondo and the others’ carefully crafted stage direction he succeeds in asking Otsu-chan out. Shinpachi’s team find themselves in a tight situation, but...?
episodes.title: Laputa's Still Good After Seeing It So Many Times

episodes.synopsis: The time to settle the battle for the official fan club title is finally here. The match between Shinpachi and Hijikata is a card battle using Otsu chip playing cards. Never knowing such a thing existed, Shinpachi rushes to the vendor for some cards. Hijikata on the other hand is fully prepared and delivers the ultra powerful card “Melancholy 5-minutes before start”! Hijikata’s range of powerful attacks forces Shinpachi to stay on the defensive. Can he possibly find a way to make a counterattack?
episodes.title: Love Is Unconditional

episodes.synopsis: After an intense battle, Shinpachi and Hijikata both fall to the ground with zero life points. Despite being exhausted and battered, the two men rise up to resume their battle. They fight as if their lives—no, their very souls—were on the line and Otsu begs them to stop. But nobody can stop them now. For their battle is no longer just for the title of official fan club...
episodes.title: The Black Ships Even Make A Scene When They Sink

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - Rumors of Yorozuya imposters gaining popularity within the city reach Gintoki’s ears. Upon investigating, the Odd Jobs Trio discover that someone is using their Yorozuya name for fishy business and making a fortune out of it. Gintoki and the gang seek out to uncover the imposters’ identities, only to discover...?!

Part 2 - A man dressed in blue full-body spandex appears before Shinpachi. The “Blue Man” begins talking to a dumbfounded Shinpachi. He claims to have come from the future, but...
episodes.title: That Matsutake Soup Stuff Tastes Better than the Real Deal / If a Person Is Dead, They Can't Come Back to Life

episodes.synopsis: The city is hit by a bad flu one winter day. Even Otae is sick with the flu. Shinpachi gets some long-awaited time alone with his sister and is tending to her when he gets a visit from Gintoki and Kagura. Turns out the two have also caught the flu and want Shinpachi to look after them. Irritated by Gintoki and Kagura’s abrupt visit, not to mention their selfish demands, Shinpachi is surprised when even more sick guests arrive.
episodes.title: If It Works Once, It'll Work Over And Over Again

episodes.synopsis: Hijikata is on a stakeout near the apartment’s dumpster. There, a sleepy Gintoki comes to throw away his trash. Finding Gintoki’s persistent intrusion a burden, Hijikata arrests Gintoki for insulting and obstructing an officer on duty. But while pushing and shoving each other, Hijikata accidentally handcuffs himself to Gintoki. Hijikata calls Okita who is staking out a different location to come and unlock them and take Gintoki to the Shinsengumi Headquarters. Instead, Okita puts a second pair of handcuffs on Gintoki and Hijikata. In the midst of all this, the Radical Joi Faction makes a move.
episodes.title: Two Is Better Than One. Two People Are Better Than One

episodes.synopsis: Tama works hard everyday starting early in the morning. Even when Otose tells her to take a break, Tama won’t and says she is happy just being with everyone. But Otose notices that Tama’s appearance has changed into that of an angular polygon from an old video game! While Otose and Gintoki discuss that it must have been brought on by overwork, Tama returns from shopping and has now regressed from polygons to pixels!! Why is she going through these changes? And will she be able to return to normal?!
episodes.title: Smooth Polygons Smooth Men's Hearts Too

episodes.synopsis: After learning from Gengai that Tama has been infected by a computer virus, the Odd Jobs trio launch “Operation Midget” and enter Tama’s body to eradicate the virus. Inside, they find an injured man dressed in a white body suit who begs them to deliver a message to the king. Arriving at the Leukocyte Kingdom, the gang finds the place filled with RPG-themed shops such as weapon stores, inns, and casinos. The group decides to enjoy this RPG-like world by playing at the casino and visiting the church to save their game. Joined by Tama’s avatar, Gintoki and the gang head out in search of the Leukocyte King. Let the adventure to destroy the computer virus begin!
episodes.title: The Human Body Is Like a Little Universe

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki and the gang arrive at Tama’s main system. The group tries to devise a battle strategy for fighting the Great Archfiend Tapir’s black body suit minions. But they can’t come to an agreement. Deciding it’s a waste of time, Kagura charges alone into the swarm of black body suits. Using this as a diversion, the group storms the enemy base, only to be surrounded after Gintoki and the Leukocyte King get into an argument. But during their rumble to decide who’s the strongest, the two wind up destroying the black body suit minions. And finally, the Great Archfiend Tapir appears!
episodes.title: The Chosen Idiots

episodes.synopsis: At last, Gintoki and his friends confront the Great Archfiend. While the Leukocyte King can’t lay a finger on the Great Archfiend who has taken Tama’s form, Gintoki attacks without giving a damn. Angered by his reckless impudence, the Leukocyte King turns on Gintoki. The Great Archfiend then takes the form of the Leukocyte King’s father. But this time Shinpachi and Kagura attack him, and they succeed in kicking him off the throne. The Odd Jobs trio takes this chance to finish the Great Archfiend off, but...
episodes.title: And into the Legend...

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - On top of the Odd Jobs building, two awfully familiar men seem to be scheming. They manage to hide themselves from several visitors, but they are spotted by the man who’ll cause the biggest mess of all: Katsura!

Part 2 - Gintoki’s alarm goes off, and he decides to takes a shower to sober up. While in the shower, something happens to Gintoki! Seems Kagura and Shinpachi are also caught up in the mess, and they wonder how this could have happened to them... The three heroes face a crisis like none other!
episodes.title: If You Keep Copying, They Will Retaliate / A Loss Opens Your Eyes to the Love You Have

episodes.synopsis: A man called Executioner Kohei is brought under strict guard to the Shinsengumi. He is the executive officer of the Radical Joi Faction, the Akatsuki Party, and is also a lethal murderer who has killed 35 bakufu officials. According to Kondo, Kohei not only endures torture, but laughs with joy during it. The Shinsengumi’s mission is to get Kohei to tell them details about the large-scale terrorist attack the Akatsuki Party is supposedly planning. First off is Yamazaki, who goes to the investigation room to take a stab at it! Will he be able to get Kohei to talk?!
episodes.title: Using the Carrot and the Stick Method Depends on the Situation

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - While taking Sadaharu out for a walk, Gintoki runs into Katsura who is with some “thing” that hardly resembles Elizabeth. Shinpachi and Kagura also notice the change in Elizabeth, or more like being totally replaced, and decide to bring Katsura back to his senses.

Part 2 - It is morning and Gintoki wakes up in his closet for some reason. Dumbfounded, he makes his way to his bedroom after going to the bathroom, only to find himself already sleeping in his bed. Realizing that something funny is happening to him yet again, he tries to resolve it through trial and error.
episodes.title: It's What's On The Inside That Counts / It's What's On The Inside That Counts, But Only To A Certain Extent

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - The Yorozuya are sent out on a tuna fishing boat to pay off their debts. There, they meet some old men they've seen somewhere before...

Part 2 - Gintoki and his friends, who have obtained a large sum of money from a request from the president of a large company, are excited to go eat Yakiniku, but...
episodes.title: Are There Still People Who Go to the Ocean and Yell "Bakayaro!"? / When a Person Is Trapped, Their Inner Door Opens

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki’s mouth is swollen like crazy, forcing him to go to the dentist for treatment. Unable to cope with the stress and pressure of waiting, a crazed Gintoki screams for someone to just kill him and be done with it. After getting scolded by the staff, Gintoki waits for his turn when another man with a swollen mouth comes in, making things even more complicated!
episodes.title: No Matter How Old You Get, You Still Hate the Dentist

episodes.synopsis: A look back at Gintama's best moments.
episodes.title: Countdown Begins

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki and the gang return to Yoshiwara at Hinowa’s request for the first time in a while. Although Hosen’s death has brought freedom to Yoshiwara, it’s also drawn the renewed interest of those who previously avoided Yoshiwara in fear of Hosen’s power. Yoshiwara is now troubled with an increased crime rate, especially illegal drug dealing. Odd Jobs are asked to capture the man responsible. The man in question is said to go by various names, titles, and even faces. The only clue available is the tattooed spider on his neck.
episodes.title: It's Bad Luck to See a Spider at Night

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki and Tsukuyo infiltrate the Benigumoto, the Red Spiders, to get a lead on the man with the tattooed spider on his neck, but are discovered and quickly surrounded. The two manage to fend for themselves, when the man with the tattooed spider makes a sudden appearance and attacks Gintoki! The man then speaks as if he knows Tsukuyo. Who is this man?!
episodes.title: Once You’re Entangled in a Spiderweb, It’s Hard to Get It Off

episodes.synopsis: Tsukuyo falls into the hands of Jiraia, her former master, and is held captive. Meanwhile Gintoki manages to survive the attack thanks to Zenzo, and he learns about Jiraia’s past. During the Amanto attack twenty years ago, Jiraia is said to have killed his own people within the Oniwabanshu, all for the sake of his devotion to the previous shogun. In the end Jiraia himself was the one to be terminated, but he managed to escape. Now his devotion is directed toward his own creation, Tsukuyo. Jiraia’s motive is to eliminate the bond that she has come to rely upon. And he intends to achieve that goal by setting fire to Yoshiwara and burning down everything!
episodes.title: It's the Irresponsible One Who's Scary When Pissed

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki strikes down Jiraia and frees Tsukuyo from his twisted web. Chiding Tsukuyo for trying to shoulder every burden herself, Gintoki goes on to say that rather than throw away your life to die beautifully, it’s far better to live and be yourself – even if your life is not a pretty one. And finally, Gintoki expresses his anger toward Jiraia for betraying his own student, despite calling himself a master.
episodes.title: The More Precious the Burden, The Heavier and More Difficult it is to Shoulder

episodes.synopsis: The city of Yoshiwara is making its recovery, though Tsukuyo has shut herself in her room. Hinowa asks Gintoki to help Tsukuyo have some fun for a change. It turns out that Tsukuyo is only pretending to be sleeping in her room, when in reality she is sneaking out to perform her routine patrol. The gang decides to come up with a plan to help Tsukuyo cheer up, even while working.
episodes.title: Watch Out For A Set of Women and A Drink

episodes.synopsis: Character popularity results are announced to celebrate Gintama’s 182nd episode! Shinpachi is alone at the café, feeling depressed after learning that he’s still in 8th place in popularity, unchanged from the previous ranking. Yamazaki, who is in 9th place, drops by to say that boring characters such as they should aim to become the No. 1 steppingstone for others. For Shinpachi and Yamazaki, 8th and 9th place should hold the same meaning as 1st. But in reality Yamazaki can’t give up the hope of ranking higher, and runs off in tears. Shinpachi can do nothing but watch, when suddenly Yamazaki’s scream is heard in the distance!
episodes.title: Screw Popularity Votes

episodes.synopsis: Characters unhappy with the popularity poll results begin attacking high-ranking characters. Surrounded by the low-ranking characters, Shinpachi attempts to escape across the rooftops but loses his footing and falls. Just when Shinpachi thinks he’s done for, he is saved by an unknown hand and manages to flee from Catherine and the other low-ranking characters. When everybody is an enemy, which character would be willing to lend a helping hand?
episodes.title: Popularity Polls Can Burn in Hell

episodes.synopsis: Shinpachi and his friends are evacuating, but a fight breaks out inside the building as well. Meanwhile, Gintoki and his group of men are attacked by Otae, Kyubei, Tsukuyo, and Sacchan! As soon as Kagura sees that Otae's side has an advantage, she quickly switches sides from Yorozuya to Otae's camp. The fight is not about ranking, but instead changes to male characters vs. female characters!
episodes.title: Popularity Polls Can...

episodes.synopsis: The Odd Jobs are requested to remove a hornets’ nest on the temple grounds. Fully armored in protective suits, what awaits the trio is a ginormous hive, like none they’ve ever seen before. Arguing that this wasn’t what they signed up for, Gintoki prepares to leave, but Kagura goes off and destroys the hive. The trio quickly plays dead to avoid getting attacked by the raging hornets, but are instead greeted by something quite unexpected...
episodes.title: Hometowns and Boobs Are Best Thought of from Afar / The Whole Peeing on a Bee Sting Is a Myth. You’ll Get Germs, So Don’t Do It!!

episodes.synopsis: Okita is going through a selection of sweets at the cake shop. As Okita leaves the store, a girl suddenly comes up and stabs him!! Calling Okita her father’s killer, the girl’s action seems to be fueled by a past case called the “Rokkaku Incident.” What is the connection between this incident and Okita, as well as the girl’s father? And more importantly, what’s the fate of Okita who’s been stabbed right at the start of this episode?!
episodes.title: Beware of Foreshadows

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki and Shinpachi start re-investigating the Rokkaku incident. Upon learning what really happened from Kamiyama, one of Okita’s subordinates, they leave to save Okita. Meanwhile, Okita is captured by Sotatsu Tendo after falling into his trap involving Kirie. Tendo babbles on about how he returned to seek revenge against Okita, who destroyed the Sokai Faction, and goes on to reveal the truth about Kirie’s father.
episodes.title: It’s Goodbye Once a Flag Is Set

episodes.synopsis: Students at a temple school share their independent research projects completed during the past summer vacation. After one of the students finishes reading a well-written journal, the last one to present is a kid named Daigoro. Sleeping in on the first day of summer vacation, Daigoro arrived late at the radio exercises and met Madao, and decided to keep an observation journal about him.
episodes.title: An Observation Journal Should Be Seen Through To The Very End

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 -  While researching the Anti-Foreigner War, a reporter interviews Nagai, a former reporter from the war called Nagai in order to know about the White Demon's (Gintoki's alter-ego) activities in such time. He chronicles the events from war, explaining how the samurais decided to fight against the aliens. As Nagai is about to talk about the White Demon, he replaces him with the fictional robot Gundam to celebrate the 30th anniversary of the franchise with the same name.

Part 2 - Kagura starts going to Kabuki-cho's physical fitness lessons where she meets a kid named Hongou Hiashi, whom she befriends. Suffering from a dangerous disease that weakens his body, Hiashi is absent from various lessons even though he promised Kagura to go to every lesson. During a rainy day, Kagura is the only person to come to the lesson, but Gintoki and her friends decide to join her. Next day, Hiashi returns to another lesson and sees Kagura once again.
episodes.title: We Know It’s Best to Finish Yearly Tasks Before the End of the Year, But then You Put It Off Till Next Year for a Fresh Start. That’s How the End of the Year Goes / Radio Exercises are Socials for Boys and Girls

episodes.synopsis: While on a job observing stray cats at a shrine feeding themselves,the Yorozuya waiting for the boss cat to show up with the name Hoichi. But as he finally shows up, and Kagura and Shinpachi jump out of the bushes to capture him, he escapes easily. So they ask Gintoki to help out, when they notice that he mysteriously disappeared.
episodes.title: When Looking For Something, Try Using its Perspective

episodes.synopsis: Having turned into cats, Gintoki,Katsura and Kondo (who turned into a gorilla) are brought by Hoichi to Otose to get food. While eating, Otose tells them that if caught, they can never return to this town.
episodes.title: Freedom Means to Live True to Yourself, not Without Law!

episodes.synopsis: While protecting Gintoki from the stray cats, Hoichi and the cats get caught. Soon Gintoki, Katsura and Kondo goes to save him.
episodes.title: Kabukicho Stray Cat Blues

episodes.synopsis: After eating egg over rice for three days straight, Gintama is fed up with Kagura being the cook in charge and doesn't want any egg over rice. Frustrated by Gin's reaction Kagura goes over to Shinachi's house to talk to Otae. Then Otae asks her if she wants to join a cooking class with her. Together with Shinpachi and other odd faces they start the cooking class.
episodes.title: Cooking is About Guts

episodes.synopsis: The episode begins with a short sequence about Kamui transferring into Yato High School and is told from Abuto's point of view. While the Shinsengumi are out on a mission, Hijikata notices snot coming out of Kondo's nose so he wonders how he could tell him without the others noticing Kondos problem. In the end the snot even takes control over Kondo's body and it comes out that Kondo's true identity is being an Amanto in snot form. As Hijikata destroys it, he realizes it has been all a dream.
episodes.title: Whenever I Hear Leviathan, I Think of Sazae-san. Stupid Me!!

episodes.synopsis: Lately the weather forecasts Ketsuno Ana is predicting are always wrong. When Gintoki meets her on the streets he takes her to the Yorozuya's place to help her.But after a monster attacks the house,it is revealed that Ketsuno Anna is an onmyouji and some other onmyouji is targeting her. After that Gintoki and the others are on the way to the Ketsuno residence,where they fight some odd creatures.
episodes.title: Not Losing to the Rain

episodes.synopsis: Weather girl Ketsuno Ana is giving the wrong weather forecast. Turns out she comes from a line of traditional Onmyojis, and her forecast is not derived from mere fortune-telling but actually by using her Onmyoji powers. But her weather forecast is being sabotaged by someone who is unhappy with Ketsuno Ana's career as a weather girl despite her being an Onmyoji. Gintoki and the gang arrive at the Onmyoji mansion where they come face to face with Seimei, Ketsuno Ana's older brother.
episodes.title: Not Losing to the Wind

episodes.synopsis: In order to save Ketsuno Ana, Seimei agrees to Douman's proposal of a Shikigami Tag-Team Mystic Death Match. Seimei arrives at the arena only to be captured by Douman, but Gintoki and the gang appears to lend a helping hand. The first match ends in a draw after both the Ketsuno and Shirino clan contestants are disqualified. After seeing how they performed in the first round, Seimei accepts Gintoki and the gang's skills, and together they prepare for the next round. Rather than making a casting spells fight, Gintoki and Ketsuno Ana's shikigami, Gedomaru, try to beat up Douman, but are caught in one of Douman's illusion and Gintoki has his testicles rip off by Gedomaru's weapon. As Gintoki's testicles are accidentally damaged by Gedomaru, Seimei decides to fight Douman alone while the shikigami heal Gintoki.
episodes.title: Not Losing to the Storm

episodes.synopsis: Seimei takes the risk of being dismissed as lead guardian of Edo by undoing the Shikigami placed throughout the city, and fueling himself with all their power to face Douman. Their fierce magic clashes, and Douman is forced onto the defensive as Seimei's techniques overwhelm him. Just when the battle seems over, Douman recalls the history between his family and the Ketsuno clan as repeatedly told by his father.
episodes.title: Never Losing that Smile

episodes.synopsis: Consumed by negative emotions, Douman is transformed into a giant demon. He now possesses within his body Antenmaru, a demon sealed away over a millennium ago by the desperate efforts of the Ketsuno and Shirino clans. As Seimei is about to be killed by Antenmaru, Gintoki stands before him with his aura-charged wooden sword. Gintoki charges his sword with everybody's energy including Douman's in order to overwhelm Antenmaru and bring a sunny day. After Antenmaru is destroyed, Gintoki leaves so that Ketsuno Ana will not know about the fight. However, he requests Gedomaru to make Ketsuno Ana to give him her autograph. Douman appears alive and ends up having a childish fight against Seimei. As Odd Jobs leave, Ketsuno Ana expresses her thanks to Gintoki in her weather forecast.
episodes.title: That’s How I Wish to Be, Beautiful and Strong

episodes.synopsis: It's Christmas in Edo and Kagura writes her father a letter. She is sad that Santa Claus never visited her. Moved, her father Umi Bozu dresses himself up as Santa and hides watching Kagura, Otae, Shinpachi and Hasegawa celebrate Christmas. When he finally jumps out of the bushes to surprise her there is another Santa, a dressed up Gintoki. Both of them think that their counterpart is real. They start punching each other when another three Santas show up (Sachan, Kondo and Kyubei). Kagura decides on a contest to see who's the real Santa.
episodes.title: Santa Claus Red Is Blood Red

episodes.synopsis: The contest has finally begun but instead of a real contest to decide who's the real Santa, Kagura, Otae and the five Santas together with Shinpachi and Hasegawa are shown in various scenes playing a role like a school girl and not fighting each other like in a real contest. In each scene they imagine, the Santa has to show his kind of version what he would do as Santa and this is judged by Kagura, Otae and Hasegawa. Although in the end none of the Santas has any desire to continue with this contest so they all quit. The episode ends with Kagura, all along figured out the identity of everyone, wishing everybody a Merry Christmas.
episodes.title: Everybody's a Santa!
